topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe this is happening. I found out the job my friend's been talking about, the one they've been bragging about for months— Turns out, it doesn't exist. Every detail, a complete fabrication. How do you even process something like this? I mean, I thought we were close. I trusted them. Now, I don't know what to think or feel. Do I confront them? But what if that just pushes them away? Maybe they have their reasons, but it's hard to see past the betrayal. I just wish I could understand why they felt they had to lie. I guess there's only one way to find out, but my heart is racing just thinking about having this conversation.
